# Carry Us Away

Artist: Circa Survive

## Lyrics

```text
[Verse 1]
This is not a riddle

I'll be your loyal apostle

[Pre-Chorus]

[Chorus]

[Verse 2]

[Pre-Chorus]
Well what would you expect to say?
It never mattered anyway

[Chorus]
There'll be a site and an invisible light
Shone down on them and took them in
There'll be a time when maybe tonight
Temptation wins and I give in

[Verse 3]
```
